messages:
Ben Patel: heads up — BigBank POC kickoff tomorrow. They want streaming responses + function calls to our tooling for account lookups. Also need structured JSON output for transaction summaries. Can an SE join?
Asha Singh: I'm on it, @Ben. Can you paste the customer's expected schema for the summary?
Ben Patel: They want {transaction_id, amount_usd, merchant, category, flagged: bool, confidence_score}. Needs to be strict JSON, no extra fields.
Carlos Rivera: FYI pricing Q from procurement — they asked for 6 months Dedicated vs Hosted cost estimate, and if we can cap monthly spend.
Asha Singh: For streaming + function-calling sample, try this minimal node snippet:
```js
const client = new Redwood.Client({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
const stream = client.streaming.chat({model: 'redwood-large', streaming: true});
stream.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk));
stream.on('end', () => console.log('done'));
// For tool calls, register tools on the server side and call via `@toolName(args)` in the prompt
```
Emily Zhang: From eng: function-calling uses structured schema enforcement on the runtime — we can return JSON via `structured_output` flag. Example: `structured_output: {json_schema: ...}`. We'll need the exact JSON schema to validate.
Asha Singh: Security questionnaire Q: do we support customer-managed KMS for Private? Yes — Private + Dedicated can integrate with KMS/HSM. I'll attach SSO and audit log docs after this thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
Ben Patel: Legal says they need SOC2 + data residency in EU region. Are we green?
Carlos Rivera: Hosted is fine with EU region, SOC2 in progress but we have SOC2 type II report draft — I'll escalate.
Asha Singh: Blocker: BigBank wants streaming at sub-200ms token latency — Emily, can we confirm target on our Dedicated config?
Emily Zhang: We can meet ~120–180ms on Dedicated with 80-token sequences and batching off. For strict SLO we recommend Dedicated or Private with reserved capacity.
Ben Patel: Great. Action items: Asha — send schema & sample SDK snippet to customer; Carlos — produce Dedicated vs Hosted 6-month cost model and cap options; Emily — confirm latency numbers and a staging runway.
Asha Singh: On it. I'll also ping security for questionnaire answers.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire document uploaded: /docs/sec/bigbank-answer-2024.pdf :page_facing_up:
Carlos Rivera: I'll set a 1-hr sync tomorrow after kickoff to run through the integration plan.
Ben Patel: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
